                local function tg(mg)
                    local Mg, Sg, yg, Dg =
                        tonumber(mg.Min) or 0,
                        tonumber(mg.Max) or 100,
                        tonumber(mg.Default),
                        tonumber(mg.Increment or mg.Step)
                    local function hg(Rg)
                        Rg = tonumber(Rg)
                        if not Rg then
                            return 0
                        end
                        for gg = 0, 6, 1 do
                            local ig = 10 ^ gg
                            if math.abs(Rg * ig - math.round(Rg * ig)) < 1.0E-6 then
                                return gg
                            end
                        end
                        return 6
                    end
                    local Rg = mg.AllowDecimals
                    Rg = if Rg == nil then mg.Decimals else Rg
                    local gg, ig
                    if Rg == nil then
                        gg = hg(Dg) > 0 or hg(Mg) > 0 or hg(Sg) > 0 or hg(yg) > 0
                        ig = gg
                    else
                        gg = Rg == true
                        ig = gg
                    end
                    local Rg, gg, Wg = tonumber(mg.DecimalPlaces or mg.Precision), 0
                    if ig then
                        gg = math.clamp(math.floor(Rg or math.max(1, hg(Dg), hg(Mg), hg(Sg), (hg(yg)))), 1, 6)
                        Wg = gg
                    else
                        Wg = gg
                    end
                    local function gg(dg)
                        dg = tonumber(dg) or 0
                        if not ig then
                            return math.round(dg)
                        end
                        local Lg = 10 ^ Wg
                        return math.round(dg * Lg) / Lg
                    end
                    local dg = gg(Mg)
                    local Mg = gg(Sg)

                    else
                        Lg, cg = dg, Mg
                    end

                                        Format = type(xg.Format) == "function" and xg.Format or nil,
                                        FromBase = type(xg.FromBase) == "function" and xg.FromBase or nil,
                                        ToBase = type(xg.ToBase) == "function" and xg.ToBase or nil,
                                    }
                                )
                            end
                        end
                        return og
                    end
                    yg, Sg = mg.Unit or mg.Units
                    if type(yg) == "string" then
                        Sg = yg
                        yg = { Options = { Sg } }
                    else
                        if type(yg) == "table" and yg.Options == nil and yg.List == nil and #yg > 0 then
                            Sg = yg
                            yg = { Options = Sg }
                        else
                            yg = if type(yg) ~= "table" then nil else yg
                        end
                    end

                    local function kg(ng)
                        if type(ng) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end
                        if typeof(ng.Unit) == "Color3" then
                            ag.Prefix = ng.Unit
                            ag.Suffix = ng.Unit
                        end
                        local jg = { "Number", "Prefix", "Suffix" }

                        if eg <= Lg then
                            local Bg = Lg
                            return Bg
                        end
                        if eg >= cg then
                            local Bg = cg
                            return Bg
                        end
                        local Bg, Kg = math.floor((eg - Lg) / dg + 0.5), Lg
                        local eg, FL = Kg + Bg * dg, math.clamp
                        local Bg, Kg, QL = gg(eg), Lg, cg
                        return FL(Bg, Kg, QL)
                    end

                                table.insert(vg, rg)
                            else
                                if (rg == "." or rg == ",") and ig and not Ng then
                                    table.insert(vg, ".")

                local dg, Lg = {}, 256
                local function cg(fg, Og)
                    assert(
                        type(fg) == "table" and fg._kind == Og and not fg._destroyed,
                        ("API nay chi dung duoc tren %s con hoat dong"):format(Og)
                    )
                end
                local function fg(Og, ug)
                    if type(Og) ~= "table" then
                        return Og
                    end
                    ug = ug or {}
                    if ug[Og] then
                        return nil
                    end
                    ug[Og] = true
                    local og = {}
                    for Vg, xg in pairs(Og) do
                        local bg = fg(Vg, ug)
                        if bg ~= nil then
                            og[bg] = fg(xg, ug)
                        end
                    end
                    ug[Og] = nil
                    return og
                end
                local function Og(ug, og, Vg)
                    if ug == og then
                        return true
                    end
                    if type(ug) ~= type(og) then
                        return false
                    elseif type(ug) ~= "table" then
                        return false
                    end
                    Vg = Vg or {}
                    if Vg[ug] == og then
                        return true
                    end
                    Vg[ug] = og
                    for xg, bg in pairs(ug) do
                        if not (Og(bg, og[xg], Vg)) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    for Vg in pairs(og) do
                        if ug[Vg] == nil then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    return true
                end
                local function ug(og, Vg, ...)
                    if type(og) ~= "function" then
                        return Vg
                    end
                    local xg = table.pack(...)
                    local bg, wg = xpcall(function()
                        return og(table.unpack(xg, 1, xg.n))
                    end, function(og)
                        return debug.traceback(tostring(og), 2)
                    end)
                    if not bg then
                        return Vg
                    end
                    return wg
                end
                local function og(Vg)
                    if type(Vg) == "table" then
                        if Vg._kind == "State" then
                            cg(Vg, "State")
                            return Vg
                        end
                    end
                    if type(Vg) == "table" then
                        if Vg._kind == "Option" then
                            cg(Vg, "Option")
                            assert(Vg.State, "This feature has no state to link")
                            return Vg.State
                        end
                    end
                    error("Provide a State or a feature with a state", 3)
                end
                local function Vg(xg)
                    xg._primaryOption = nil
                    local bg
                    for wg in pairs(xg._views) do
                        if wg._destroyed then
                        else
                            if wg.Instance ~= nil then
                                bg = bg or wg
                                if type(wg._userCallback) == "function" then
                                    xg._primaryOption = wg
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    xg._primaryOption = bg
                end
                local function xg(bg)
                    for wg, ag in pairs(bg._views) do
                        if wg._destroyed or wg.Instance == nil then
                            bg._views[wg] = nil
                        elseif wg._controller.SetValue then
                            local Cg = ug(ag.ToOption, bg.Value, fg(bg.Value), wg, bg)
                            wg._stateApplying = true
                            xpcall(function()
                                wg._controller.SetValue(fg(Cg), false)
                            end, function(ag)
                                return debug.traceback(tostring(ag), 2)
                            end)
                            wg._stateApplying = false
                        end
                    end
                    if bg._primaryOption then
                        if bg._primaryOption._destroyed then
                            Vg(bg)
                        elseif bg._primaryOption.Instance == nil then
                            Vg(bg)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function bg(wg, ag)
                    if wg.changed[ag] then
                        return
                    end
                    wg.changed[ag] = true
                    table.insert(wg.order, ag)
                end
                Wg[1] = function(wg, ag, Cg, kg)
                    if wg._destroyed then
                        return false
                    end
                    if Cg.steps >= Lg then
                        if not Cg.warned then
                            Cg.warned = true
                        end
                        return false
                    end
                    local Lg = ug(wg.Normalize, ag, fg(ag), wg)
                    if Lg == dg then
                        return false
                    end
                    for ag in pairs(wg._groups) do
                        if not (Wg[17](ag, wg, Lg)) then
                            xg(wg)
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    if Og(wg.Value, Lg) then
                        xg(wg)
                        return false
                    end
                    Cg.steps = Cg.steps + 1
                    wg.Value = fg(Lg)
                    bg(Cg, wg)
                    xg(wg)
                    for bg in pairs(wg._groups) do
                        Wg[18](bg, wg, Cg)
                    end
                    for bg, bg in ipairs(wg._links) do
                        if bg.Connected then
                            Lg = ug(bg.Transform, wg.Value, fg(wg.Value), fg(bg.Target.Value), wg, bg.Target)
                            if Lg ~= dg then
                                Wg[1](bg.Target, Lg, Cg, kg)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return true
                end
                local function Lg(bg)
                    local wg = bg._registered
                    return if wg then type(bg.Callback) ~= "function" else not wg
                end
                local function bg(wg, ag, Cg, kg, ng)
                    local jg = {
                        changed = {},
                        fireCallback = Cg ~= false,
                        order = {},
                        sourceArguments = ng,
                        sourceOption = kg,
                        steps = 0,
                        warned = false,
                    }
                    Wg[1](wg, ag, jg, kg)
                    if jg.fireCallback then
                        for ag, ag in ipairs(jg.order) do
                            G(ag.Callback, fg(ag.Value), ag, kg)
                            wg = ag._primaryOption
                            if Lg(ag) then
                                if wg then
                                    if not wg._destroyed then
                                        if type(wg._userCallback) == "function" then
                                            if wg == kg and ng then
                                                G(wg._userCallback, table.unpack(ng, 1, ng.n))
                                            else
                                                G(wg._userCallback, wg._controller.GetValue())
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            for wg, wg in ipairs(ag._subscribers) do
                                if wg.Connected then
                                    G(wg.Callback, fg(ag.Value), ag, kg)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        Cg = nil
                        if if kg then kg._destroyed else not kg then
                            Cg = kg
                            for wg, wg in ipairs(jg.order) do
                                for ag in pairs(wg._views) do
                                    if not ag._destroyed then
                                        if not ag._configIgnored then
                                            Cg = ag
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if Cg then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            Cg = kg
                        end
                        if Cg and t.optionChangedHook then
                            t.optionChangedHook(Cg)
                        elseif #jg.order > 0 then
                            if t.stateChangedHook then
                                t.stateChangedHook(jg.order[1])
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return #jg.order > 0
                end
                local function wg(ag, Cg, kg)
                    local ng = setmetatable(
                        {
                            _kind = "State",

                            _configIgnored = Cg.Save == false or Cg.Config == false,

                                    break

                            else
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                Wg[17] = function(ag, Cg, kg)
                    if kg ~= false then
                        return true
                    elseif Cg.Value ~= true then
                        return true
                    end
                    return Wg[14](ag) - 1 >= ag.MinActive
                end
                Wg[18] = function(ag, Cg, kg)
                    if Cg.Value == true then
                        ag._nextActivationOrder = ag._nextActivationOrder + 1
                        ag._activationOrder[Cg] = ag._nextActivationOrder
                        Wg[16](ag, Cg, kg, nil)
                    else
                        ag._activationOrder[Cg] = nil
                    end
                end
                Wg[19] = function(ag, Cg)
                    cg(ag, "ExclusiveGroup")
                    local kg = og(Cg)
                    assert(kg.Window == ag.Window, "State and Feature must belong to the same Window")
                    if ag._members[kg] then
                        return ag
                    end
                    ag._members[kg] = true
                    kg._groups[ag] = true
                    if kg.Value == true then
                        ag._nextActivationOrder = ag._nextActivationOrder + 1
                        ag._activationOrder[kg] = ag._nextActivationOrder
                        Wg[16](ag, kg, nil, false)
                    end
                    return ag
                end

                    kg._groups[ag] = nil
                    return ag

                Wg[22] = function(ag, Cg, kg)

                Wg[23] = function(ag)
                    cg(ag, "ExclusiveGroup")

                            table.insert(Cg, kg)
                        end

                Wg[28] = function(ag)
                    cg(ag, "ExclusiveGroup")
                    ag._destroyed = true

                                break
                            end
                        end

                local function ag(Cg, kg, ng)
                    cg(kg, "State")
                    assert(
                        kg.Window == Cg.Section.Tab.Window,
                        "State and Feature must belong to the same Window"
                    )
                    local jg = { FromOption = ng.OptionToState, ToOption = ng.StateToOption }
                    Cg.State = kg
                    Cg._stateBinding = jg
                    kg._views[Cg] = jg
                    if kg._primaryOption then
                        if type(kg._primaryOption._userCallback) ~= "function" then
                            if type(Cg._userCallback) == "function" then
                                kg._primaryOption = Cg
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        kg._primaryOption = Cg
                    end
                    xg(kg)
                end
                local function xg(Cg, kg, ng, jg)
                    local _g = setmetatable(
                        {
                            _kind = "Option",
                            _destroyed = false,
                            _controller = jg or {},
                            _manualVisible = true,
                            _resolvedVisible = true,
                            _visibilityDependencies = {},
                            _visibilityDependents = {},
                            Section = Cg,
                            Type = kg,
                            Name = ng.Name,
                            Instance = ng,
                        },
                        hg
                    )
                    table.insert(Cg.Options, _g)
                    return _g
                end

                Wg[30] = function(Cg, kg, ng)
                    cg(Cg, "Option")

                    if Cg.State then
                        if not Cg._stateApplying then
                            jg(kg, false)
                            local _g = Cg._controller.GetValue()
                            local Yg = ug(Cg._stateBinding.FromOption, _g, fg(_g), Cg, Cg.State)
                            bg(Cg.State, Yg, ng, Cg)

                                if not (Lg(Cg.State)) then
                                    G(Cg._userCallback, Cg._controller.GetValue())
                                end
                            end

                local function Cg(kg)
                    local ng = Wg[2](kg.Source)
                    if kg.Predicate then
                        local jg, _g = pcall(kg.Predicate, fg(ng), kg.Source, kg.Child)
                        return jg and _g == true
                    end
                    return Og(ng, kg.Expected)
                end
                local function Og(kg, ng)
                    if kg._manualVisible == false then
                        return false
                    end
                    for jg, _g in ipairs(kg._visibilityDependencies or {}) do
                        if _g.Connected then
                            if not (Cg(_g)) then
                                return false
                            end
                            jg = _g.SourceOption
                            if jg then
                                if jg._destroyed then
                                else
                                    local Cg = ng or {}
                                    if not Cg[jg] then
                                        Cg[jg] = true
                                        if not (Og(jg, Cg)) then
                                            return false
                                        end
                                    end
                                    ng = Cg
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    return true
                end
                Wg[43] = function(Cg)
                    local kg = #(Cg._visibilityDependencies or {}) > 0 and 0.96 or 1
                    kg = if Cg._subOfParent then 0.9 else kg
                    Cg._visibilityHostWidth = kg
                    if Cg._visibilityHost then
                        if Cg._visibilityHost.Parent then
                            local ng = Cg._visibilityHost.Size
                            Cg._visibilityHost.Size = UDim2.new(kg, 0, ng.Y.Scale, ng.Y.Offset)
                            return Cg._visibilityHost
                        end
                    end
                    local ng = Cg.Instance
                    local jg = ng and ng.Parent
                    if not ng or not jg then
                        return ng
                    end
                    local _g = Instance.new("Frame")
                    _g.Name = ng.Name .. "CollapsibleContent"
                    _g.Active = false
                    _g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    _g.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    _g.ClipsDescendants = true
                    _g.LayoutOrder = ng.LayoutOrder
                    _g.Size = UDim2.new(kg, 0, 0, math.max(1, ng.AbsoluteSize.Y))
                    _g.Visible = ng.Visible
                    _g.ZIndex = ng.ZIndex
                    _g.Parent = jg
                    ng.LayoutOrder = 1
                    ng.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                    ng.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
                    ng.Visible = true
                    ng.Parent = _g
                    Cg._visibilityHost = _g
                    Cg._visibilityAnimating = false
                    Cg._visibilityHostConnections = Cg._visibilityHostConnections or {}
                    local function kg()
                        if Cg._destroyed then
                            return
                        elseif _g.Parent then
                            if not ng.Parent then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        local jg = math.max(1, ng.AbsoluteSize.Y, ng.Size.Y.Offset)
                        Cg._visibilityExpandedHeight = jg
                        if not Cg._visibilityAnimating then
                            if Cg._resolvedVisible ~= false then
                                _g.Size = UDim2.new(Cg._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, jg)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    table.insert(
                        Cg._visibilityHostConnections,
                        ng:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(kg)
                    )
                    table.insert(
                        Cg._visibilityHostConnections,
                        ng:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(kg)
                    )
                    kg()
                    return _g
                end
                Wg[44] = function(Cg, kg)
                    local ng = {}
                    cg(Cg, "Option")
                    local jg, _g = Cg._resolvedVisible, Og(Cg)
                    Cg._resolvedVisible = _g
                    if jg ~= _g and not Cg._cascadingVisibility then
                        Cg._cascadingVisibility = true
                        for Og, Yg in ipairs(Cg._visibilityDependents or {}) do
                            Og = Yg.Child
                            if Yg.Connected then
                                if Og then
                                    if not Og._destroyed then
                                        Wg[44](Og, kg)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        Cg._cascadingVisibility = false
                    end
                    local Og = Wg[43](Cg)
                    if not Og then
                        return Cg
                    end
                    if Cg._preSearchVisible ~= nil then
                        Cg._preSearchVisible = _g
                        Og.Visible = Cg._searchMatched == true and _g
                        task.defer(Cg.Section._refreshHeight)
                        return Cg
                    end
                    Cg._visibilityRevision = (Cg._visibilityRevision or 0) + 1
                    local Yg = Cg._visibilityRevision
                    jg = Cg._visibilityTween ~= nil
                    if Cg._visibilityTween then
                        Cg._visibilityTween:Cancel()
                        Cg._visibilityTween = nil
                    end
                    if Og.Visible == _g then
                        if not jg then
                            return Cg
                        end
                    end
                    if not _g and Cg._controller.Close then
                        Cg._controller.Close()
                    end
                    jg = Cg.Instance
                    local Ag = math.max(
                        1,
                        Cg._visibilityExpandedHeight or 0,
                        jg and jg.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0,
                        jg and jg.Size.Y.Offset or 0
                    )
                    Cg._visibilityExpandedHeight = Ag
                    jg = UDim2.new(Cg._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, _g and Ag or 0)
                    if _g then
                        Og.Visible = true
                    end
                    if kg == false then
                        Cg._visibilityAnimating = false
                        Og.Size = jg
                        Og.Visible = _g
                        task.defer(Cg.Section._refreshHeight)
                        return Cg
                    end
                    Cg._visibilityAnimating = true
                    kg = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                    ng[1] = (z[4]:Create(Og, kg, { Size = jg }))
                    Cg._visibilityTween = ng[1]
                    kg, jg =
                        Cg._visibilityTween, function()
                            if Cg._destroyed then
                                return
                            elseif Yg ~= Cg._visibilityRevision then
                                return
                            elseif not Cg._visibilityHost then
                                return
                            end
                            Cg._visibilityTween = nil
                            Cg._visibilityAnimating = false
                            Og.Visible = _g
                            if _g then
                                Og.Size = UDim2.new(Cg._visibilityHostWidth or 1, 0, 0, Cg._visibilityExpandedHeight or Ag)
                            end
                            Cg.Section._refreshHeight()
                            if Cg.Section._stabilizeLayout then
                                Cg.Section._stabilizeLayout()
                            end
                        end
                    kg.Completed:Connect(jg)
                    Cg._visibilityTween:Play()
                    task.defer(Cg.Section._refreshHeight)
                    return Cg
                end

                    if Cg then

                            table.insert(Cg._visibilityDependents, _g)

                        if _g.Connected then

                                            _L.GradientSource = vL.Gradient
                                            Gg(_L.Label, vL.Gradient)
                                            nL = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        if _L.StrokeGradientSource ~= vL.StrokeGradient then
                                            _L.StrokeGradientSource = vL.StrokeGradient
                                            Gg(_L.Stroke, vL.StrokeGradient)
                                            nL = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        nL = if _L.Spec ~= vL then true else nL
                                        _L.Spec = vL
                                        _L.Label.Visible = true
                                    end
                                    for Gg = #AL + 1, #CL, 1 do
                                        YL = CL[Gg]
                                        if YL.Label.Visible then
                                            YL.Label.Visible = false
                                            nL = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        YL.Spec = nil
                                    end
                                    return #AL > 0, nL
                                end
                                local function Gg(wL, CL, kL, nL, jL, _L, YL, AL, vL)
                                    local PL, eL = {}, 0
                                    for BL, KL in ipairs(wL) do
                                        BL = KL.Spec
                                        if BL then
                                            local ZL, pL = KL.Label, math.max(8, math.floor(_L * math.max(0.3, tonumber(BL.Scale) or 1) + 0.5))
                                            ZL.FontFace = _g(BL.Font or YL)
                                            ZL.TextSize = pL
                                            ZL.TextColor3 = Ag(BL.Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
                                            ZL.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, nL), math.max(1, jL))
                                            local rL = KL.Stroke
                                            rL.Color = Ag(BL.StrokeColor, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
                                            rL.Transparency = math.clamp(tonumber(BL.StrokeTransparency) or 0, 0, 1)
                                            rL.Thickness = math.max(0.5, tonumber(BL.StrokeThickness) or math.max(1, pL * 0.1))
                                            rL = ZL.TextBounds.X
                                            if rL <= 0 then
                                                rL, OL = (utf8.len(ZL.Text) or #ZL.Text) * pL * 0.62, true
                                            else
                                            end
                                            ZL = math.max(1, math.ceil(rL + pL * 0.08))
                                            table.insert(PL, { Part = KL, Width = ZL })
                                            eL += ZL
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if #PL == 0 then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    YL = math.max(0, vL) * (#PL - 1)
                                    wL, _L = eL + YL > nL and math.max(0.2, (nL - YL) / math.max(1, eL)) or 1, YL
                                    for YL, YL in ipairs(PL) do
                                        YL.Width = math.max(1, math.floor(YL.Width * wL))
                                        _L += YL.Width
                                    end
                                    wL = if AL == Enum.TextXAlignment.Center then CL + math.max(0, (nL - _L) / 2) else if AL == Enum.TextXAlignment.Right then CL + math.max(0, nL - _L) else CL
                                    for CL, CL in ipairs(PL) do
                                        AL = CL.Part.Label
                                        AL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(wL, kL)
                                        AL.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CL.Width, jL)
                                        wL += CL.Width + vL
                                    end
                                end
                                local function wL()
                                    if not sL.SearchEnabled then
                                        return ""
                                    end
                                    return string.lower(string.match(sL.Query, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "")
                                end
                                local function CL(kL, nL)
                                    return nL == "" or string.find(Pg(kL), nL, 1, true) ~= nil
                                end
                                local function kL(nL)
                                    local jL = nL.Spec
                                    local _L = jL ~= nil and jL.Kind == "item"
                                    if _L and jL.Id ~= nil and jL.Id == sL.Selected then
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Ag(qg.SelectedBackgroundColor, Sg)
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(qg.SelectedBackgroundTransparency) or 0.86, 0, 1)
                                    elseif _L and nL.Hovered and FL then
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Ag(qg.HoverBackgroundColor, Cg)
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(qg.HoverBackgroundTransparency) or 0.93, 0, 1)
                                    elseif _L then
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Ag(qg.ItemBackgroundColor, Cg)
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(qg.ItemBackgroundTransparency) or 1, 0, 1)
                                    else
                                        nL.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                    end
                                end
                                local function Sg()
                                    local nL = Instance.new("Frame")

                                    local PL = { Frame = nL, Corner = Cg, Image = jL, ImageCorner = _L, ImageStroke = YL, Label = AL, TitleLabel = Tg, TitleStroke = Ug, TitleParts = { { Label = Tg, Stroke = Ug, GradientSource = nil, Spec = nil } }, TopRightLabel = vL, TopRightText = nil, TitleText = nil, GradientSource = nil, Button = Jg, Text = nil, ImageId = nil, MeasuredWidth = -1, MeasuredKey = nil, MeasuredHeight = 0, Hovered = false, Spec = nil }

                                        PL.Hovered = false
                                        kL(PL)
                                    end

                                        local Cg = PL.Spec

                                            if Cg.Kind == "item" then
                                                if Cg.Id ~= nil then

                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                end
                                local function Cg()
                                    local Tg, Ug, Jg = wL(), {}, 0
                                    if sL.Header ~= "" then
                                        table.insert(Ug, { Kind = "header", Text = sL.Header })
                                    end
                                    local function FL(wL)
                                        table.insert(Ug, { Kind = "item", Text = wL.Text, Title = wL.Title, Gradient = wL.Gradient, TitleParts = wL.TitleParts, TopRightText = wL.TopRightText, Image = wL.Image, ImageColor = wL.ImageColor, Id = wL.Id, Source = wL })
                                        Jg += 1
                                    end
                                    local function wL(nL)
                                        if CL(nL.Text, Tg) or nL.Title and CL(nL.Title, Tg) then
                                            return true
                                        elseif nL.TopRightText then
                                            if CL(nL.TopRightText, Tg) then
                                                return true
                                            end
                                        end
                                        for jL, jL in ipairs(Kg(nL.TitleParts)) do
                                            if CL(jL.Text, Tg) then
                                                return true
                                            end
                                        end
                                        return false
                                    end
                                    if sL.Groups then
                                        local Kg = Yg(qg.GroupColor, "#3AFF37")
                                        for nL, jL in ipairs(sL.Groups) do
                                            local _L, YL = Tg ~= "" and CL(jL.Title, Tg), {}
                                            for CL, CL in ipairs(jL.Items) do
                                                if _L then
                                                    table.insert(YL, CL)
                                                elseif wL(CL) then
                                                    table.insert(YL, CL)
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if #YL > 0 or Tg == "" and jL.Title ~= "" then
                                                if jL.Title ~= "" then
                                                    _L, nL = table.insert, { Kind = "group", Gap = qg.GroupSpacing and #Ug > 0 }
                                                    nL.Text = string.format('<b><font color="%s">%s</font></b> <font color="#AAAAAA">(%d)</font>', Yg(jL.Color, Kg), jL.Title, #jL.Items)
                                                    _L(Ug, nL)
                                                end
                                                for Yg, Yg in ipairs(YL) do
                                                    FL(Yg)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                        for Yg, Yg in ipairs(sL.Items) do
                                            if wL(Yg) then
                                                FL(Yg)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if Tg ~= "" then
                                        if Jg == 0 then
                                            wL, FL = table.insert, { Kind = "message" }
                                            FL.Text = string.format('<font color="#888899">No results for "%s"</font>', vg(Tg))
                                            wL(Ug, FL)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    return Ug
                                end
                                local function Yg(vg)
                                    local Kg = #vg ~= #bL
                                    bL = vg
                                    for Tg, Ug in ipairs(vg) do
                                        local Jg = xL[Tg]
                                        if Jg then
                                        else
                                            Jg = Sg()
                                            xL[Tg] = Jg
                                            Kg = true
                                        end
                                        Kg = if Jg.Spec == nil then true else if Jg.Spec.Kind ~= Ug.Kind then true else if Jg.Spec.Gap ~= Ug.Gap then true else Kg
                                        Jg.Spec = Ug
                                        if Jg.Frame.Visible then
                                        else
                                            Jg.Frame.Visible = true
                                            Kg = true
                                        end
                                        if Jg.Text ~= Ug.Text then
                                            Jg.Text = Ug.Text
                                            Jg.Label.Text = Ug.Text
                                            Jg.MeasuredWidth = -1
                                            Kg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        Tg = Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.TopRightText or nil
                                        if Jg.TopRightText ~= Tg then
                                            Jg.TopRightText = Tg
                                            Jg.TopRightLabel.Text = Tg or ""
                                            Jg.TopRightLabel.Visible = Tg ~= nil and Tg ~= ""
                                            Jg.MeasuredWidth = -1
                                            Kg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        Tg = Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.Image or nil
                                        if Jg.ImageId ~= Tg then
                                            Jg.ImageId = Tg
                                            Jg.Image.Image = Tg or ""
                                            Jg.Image.Visible = Tg ~= nil
                                            Jg.MeasuredWidth = -1
                                            Kg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        if Tg then
                                            local Sg = Ag(Ug.ImageColor, kg)
                                            if Jg.ImageStroke.Color ~= Sg then
                                                Jg.ImageStroke.Color = Sg
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local Sg, kg = aL(Jg.TitleParts, Jg.Frame, Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.TitleParts or nil, Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.Title or nil, Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.Gradient or nil, 7)
                                        Jg.TitleText = Sg and true or nil
                                        if kg then
                                            Jg.MeasuredWidth = -1
                                            Kg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        Jg.Button.Visible = Ug.Kind == "item" and Ug.Id ~= nil
                                        kL(Jg)
                                    end
                                    for Sg = #vg + 1, #xL, 1 do
                                        local kg = xL[Sg]
                                        if kg.Frame.Visible then
                                            kg.Frame.Visible = false
                                            Kg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                        kg.Spec = nil
                                    end
                                    return Kg
                                end
                                local Sg, kg, vg
                                local Kg, Tg, Ug = Vector3.zero, 10, 0
                                local function Jg()
                                    if not vg then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    local FL, wL, CL = Vector3.new(math.sin(Ug), 0.35, math.cos(Ug)).Unit, CFrame.lookAt, Kg
                                    DL.CFrame = wL(CL + FL * Tg, Kg)
                                end
                                local function FL()
                                    local wL, CL, nL, jL = sL.Spotlight, vg ~= nil, RL.Visible, tL.Visible
                                    if not wL then
                                        if vg then
                                            vg:Destroy()
                                            vg = nil
                                        end
                                        Sg, kg = nil, nil
                                        tL.Visible = false
                                        iL.Visible = false
                                        return jL
                                    end
                                    tL.Visible = true
                                    local kg = tostring(wL.Text or "")
                                    if hL.Text ~= kg then
                                        hL.Text = kg
                                    end
                                    kg = aL(gL, tL, wL.TitleParts, wL.Title ~= nil and tostring(wL.Title) or nil, wL.Gradient, 6)
                                    RL.Visible = kg
                                    iL.BackgroundColor3 = typeof(qg.SpotlightDividerColor) == "Color3" and qg.SpotlightDividerColor or Ag(wL.Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
                                    if wL.Model ~= Sg then
                                        Sg = wL.Model
                                        if vg then
                                            vg:Destroy()
                                            vg = nil
                                        end
                                        local Sg = rg(wL.Model)
                                        if Sg then
                                            local rg, aL
                                            if Sg:IsA("Model") then
                                                rg, aL = Sg:GetBoundingBox()
                                            else
                                                if Sg:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                    rg, aL = Sg.CFrame, Sg.Size
                                                else
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if rg then
                                                Kg = rg.Position
                                                local Kg = math.max(0.25, tonumber(qg.SpotlightModelScale) or 1)
                                                Tg = aL.Magnitude * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(DL.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.05 / Kg
                                                Sg.Parent = SL
                                                vg = Sg
                                                Jg()
                                            else
                                                Sg:Destroy()
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    SL.Visible = vg ~= nil
                                    wL = (if jL then CL ~= (vg ~= nil) else not jL) or nL ~= kg
                                    return wL
                                end
                                local function Sg()
                                    local kg, Kg = QL.Parent, QL.AbsoluteSize.X
                                    if kg then
                                        if Kg <= 0 then
                                            return
                                        end

                                    local Ag = table.concat({ tostring(qg.Font), jg, j, s, tostring(jL), tostring(_g), rg }, "|")
                                    local function Tg(tL)
                                        local SL, yL = bL, 0
                                        for hL, RL in ipairs(SL) do
                                            local SL, gL = xL[hL], RL.Kind == "item"
                                            local iL, bL, aL = SL.ImageId ~= nil, gL and math.floor(_L * 0.25) or 0, gL and math.floor(_L * 0.18) or 0
                                            hL = iL and rg + math.floor(_L * 0.6) or 0

                                                local pL = SL.Label

                                    CL = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(qg.MaxLines) or 0))

                                    if not qg.Model then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    local FL = Vector3.new(math.sin(qg.Angle), qg.Height, math.cos(qg.Angle)).Unit
                                    Hg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(qg.Center + FL * qg.Distance, qg.Center)

                                local function FL(QL)
                                    if qg.Model then
                                        qg.Model:Destroy()
                                        qg.Model = nil
                                    end
                                    qg.Template = QL
                                    local zL = vg(QL)
                                    if not zL then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    local vg, QL
                                    if zL:IsA("Model") then
                                        vg, QL = zL:GetBoundingBox()
                                    else
                                        if zL:IsA("BasePart") then
                                            vg, QL = zL.CFrame, zL.Size
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if not vg then
                                        zL:Destroy()
                                        return
                                    end
                                    qg.Center = vg.Position
                                    qg.Radius = QL.Magnitude * 0.5
                                    qg.Distance = qg.Radius / math.tan(math.rad(Hg.FieldOfView / 2)) * qg.Zoom
                                    zL.Parent = Eg
                                    qg.Model = zL
                                    sL()
                                end
                                local vg = rg(Jg, Eg, "Model", Gg, function()
                                    local rg = Jg._metrics
                                    pg(Jg, Eg, Gg)

                                            if Gg.WidthScale == nil then

                                                Eg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pg, pg)
                                            end
                                        end

                                        if qg.Radius then

                                H.Finalize = function(C, A)
                                    assert(not C._finalized, "NinjaLibrary:Finalize() chi duoc goi mot lan")
                                    A = type(A) == "table" and A or {}

                                            return type(Rg) == "function" and Rg or nil
                                        end

                                        hg.Available = hg.MakeFolder ~= nil and hg.Read ~= nil and hg.Write ~= nil
                                        hg.CanDelete = hg.Delete ~= nil
                                        hg.CanList = hg.List ~= nil
                                        local Rg = {}
                                        local function gg(ig)
                                            local Wg, dg = Rg[ig]
                                            if hg.Available then
                                                local Lg, cg = pcall(hg.Read, ig)
                                                if not Lg then
                                                    return nil
                                                end
                                                dg = cg
                                            else
                                                dg = Wg
                                            end
                                            if type(dg) ~= "string" then
                                                return nil
                                            elseif dg == "" then
                                                return nil
                                            end
                                            local ig, Wg = pcall(function()
                                                return Xg:JSONDecode(dg)
                                            end)
                                            return ig and Wg or nil
                                        end
                                        local function ig(Wg, dg)
                                            local Lg, cg = pcall(function()
                                                return Xg:JSONEncode(dg)
                                            end)
                                            if not Lg then
                                                return false, "JSON encode failed: " .. tostring(cg)
                                            end
                                            if hg.Available then
                                                local dg, Lg = pcall(hg.Write, Wg, cg)
                                                if not dg then
                                                    return false, "Write failed: " .. tostring(Lg)
                                                end
                                            else
                                                Rg[Wg] = cg
                                            end
                                            return true
                                        end
                                        local function Wg(dg)
                                            if hg.Available then
                                                if not hg.CanDelete then
                                                    return false, "Delete is not supported by this executor."
                                                end
                                                local Lg, cg = pcall(hg.Delete, dg)
                                                if not Lg then
                                                    return false, "Delete failed: " .. tostring(cg)
                                                end
                                            else
                                                Rg[dg] = nil
                                            end
                                            return true
                                        end
                                        local function dg(Lg)
                                            return tg .. "/" .. Lg .. ".json"
                                        end
                                        local function Lg(cg)
                                            local fg = tostring(cg or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                                            if fg == "" then
                                                return nil, "Enter a config name."
                                            end
                                            cg = utf8.len(fg)
                                            if cg then
                                                if cg > 48 then
                                                    return nil, "Config name is limited to 48 characters."
                                                end
                                            else
                                                return nil, "Config name is limited to 48 characters."
                                            end
                                            if fg == "." then
                                                return nil, "Config name contains invalid file characters."
                                            elseif fg == ".." then
                                                return nil, "Config name contains invalid file characters."
                                            elseif fg:find('[<>:"/\\|?*%c]') then
                                                return nil, "Config name contains invalid file characters."
                                            elseif fg:find("[%.%s]$") then
                                                return nil, "Config name contains invalid file characters."
                                            end
                                            cg = fg:upper()
                                            local Og = cg:match("^([^%.]+)") or cg
                                            if Og == "CON" then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og == "PRN" then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og == "AUX" then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og == "NUL" then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og == "CLOCK$" then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og:match("^COM[1-9]$") then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            elseif Og:match("^LPT[1-9]$") then
                                                return nil, "This config name is reserved by Windows."
                                            end
                                            return fg
                                        end
                                        local function cg()
                                            local fg = { [Sg:lower()] = Sg }
                                            if hg.Available and hg.CanList then
                                                local Og, ug = pcall(hg.List, tg)

                                                    for Og, og in ipairs(ug) do

                                                    end
                                                end
                                            else

                                                    local Rg = tostring(Og):gsub("\\", "/"):match("^" .. mg .. "/([^/]+)%.json$")
                                                    if Rg then
                                                        if Rg ~= "" then
                                                            fg[Rg:lower()] = Rg
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            local mg = {}
                                            for Rg, Rg in pairs(fg) do
                                                if Rg:lower() ~= Sg:lower() then
                                                    table.insert(mg, Rg)
                                                end
                                            end
                                            table.sort(mg, function(Rg, fg)
                                                return Rg:lower() < fg:lower()
                                            end)
                                            table.insert(mg, 1, Sg)
                                            return mg
                                        end
                                        local function mg(Rg)

                                            end

                                        local function Mg()
                                            local hg = {}
                                            for ug, og in ipairs(v.Tabs) do
