                                                                                local ag, Cg = pcall(function()
                                                                                    return wg:Get()
                                                                                end)
                                                                                if ag then
                                                                                    if Cg ~= nil then
                                                                                        bg = fg(Cg)
                                                                                        if bg ~= nil then
                                                                                            local ag = { Type = wg.Type, Value = bg }
                                                                                            if wg._controller.GetUnit then
                                                                                                local bg, Cg = pcall(function()
                                                                                                    return wg:GetUnit()
                                                                                                end)
                                                                                                if bg then
                                                                                                    if type(Cg) == "string" then
                                                                                                        ag.Unit = Cg
                                                                                                    end
                                                                                                end
                                                                                            end
                                                                                            Vg[wg.Name] = ag
                                                                                        end
                                                                                    end
                                                                                end
                                                                            end
                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                            if next(Vg) ~= nil then
                                                                ug[xg.Name] = Vg
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                    if next(ug) ~= nil then
                                                        hg[og.Name] = ug
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return hg
                                        end
                                        local function hg()
                                            local ug = {}
                                            for og, Vg in ipairs(v.States) do
                                                if not Vg._destroyed then
                                                    if not Vg._configIgnored then
                                                        og = fg(Vg:Get())
                                                        if og ~= nil then
                                                            ug[Vg.Name] = { Value = og }
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return ug
                                        end
                                        local ug, og
                                        local function Vg()
                                            if ug then
                                                return
                                            end
                                            ug = hg()
                                            og = Mg()
                                        end
                                        local xg, bg, wg, ag, Cg, kg, ng, jg
                                        local _g, Yg = 0, "This config loads next time; use Load Config to load now"
                                        local function Ag(vg) end
                                        local function vg()
                                            local Pg, eg = tg()
                                            if not Pg then
                                                Ag("Config state save failed: " .. tostring(eg))
                                            end
                                            return Pg, eg
                                        end
                                        local function tg()
                                            if xg then
                                                if not xg._destroyed then
                                                    xg:Set("Startup Config: " .. Og.Startup, false)
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if xg then
                                                if not xg._destroyed then
                                                    xg:SetNote(Og.Startup:lower() ~= Og.Active:lower() and Yg or "")
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function Pg()
                                            if kg then
                                                if not kg._destroyed then
                                                    kg:SetNote("Save: " .. Og.Active)
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if ng then
                                                if not ng._destroyed then
                                                    ng:SetNote("Auto save: " .. Og.Active)
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if jg then
                                                if not jg._destroyed then
                                                    jg:SetNote("Auto load: " .. Og.Startup)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function eg(Bg)
                                            local Kg = {}
                                            for Zg = 1, 4, 1 do
                                                local pg = Bg[Zg]
                                                if pg then
                                                    if not pg._destroyed then
                                                        table.insert(Kg, pg)
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return Kg
                                        end
                                        local function Bg()
                                            local Kg, Zg = cg(), { bg, wg, ag, Cg }
                                            for pg, pg in ipairs((eg(Zg))) do
                                                pg:SetOptions(Kg, nil, false)
                                            end
                                            tg()
                                            Pg()
                                        end
                                        local function Kg(Zg)
                                            local pg = { bg, ag, Cg }
                                            for rg, rg in ipairs((eg(pg))) do
                                                rg:Set(Zg, false)
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function eg(Zg, pg, rg)
                                            local Ng, Tg = Lg(Zg)
                                            if not Ng then
                                                if pg ~= false then
                                                    Ag(Tg)
                                                end
                                                return false, Tg
                                            end
                                            Tg = { Version = 2, Profile = Ng, SavedAt = os.time(), States = rg and rg.States or hg(), Values = rg and rg.Values or Mg() }
                                            Zg, rg = ig(dg(Ng), Tg)
                                            if Zg then
                                                pcall(ig, dg(Ng) .. ".bak", Tg)
                                            end
                                            if Zg and pg ~= false then
                                                Ag("Saved: " .. Ng)
                                            elseif Zg then
                                            elseif pg ~= false then
                                                Ag(rg)
                                            end
                                            return Zg, rg
                                        end
                                        local Mg
                                        local function hg(Zg)
                                            for pg, pg in ipairs(v.Tabs) do
                                                if not pg._destroyed then
                                                    for rg, rg in ipairs(pg.Sections) do
                                                        if not rg._destroyed then
                                                            for pg, pg in ipairs(rg.Options) do
                                                                if not pg._destroyed then
                                                                    if pg._visibilityDependencies then
                                                                        if #pg._visibilityDependencies > 0 then
                                                                            pg:_ApplyVisibility(Zg)
                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function Zg(pg, rg)
                                            _g += 1
                                            local Ng = mg(pg)
                                            if not Ng then
                                                local Tg = "Config does not exist: " .. tostring(pg)
                                                if rg ~= false then
                                                    Ag(Tg)
                                                end
                                                return false, Tg
                                            end
                                            pg = gg(dg(Ng))
                                            local function Tg(Ug)
                                                return type(Ug) == "table" and (type(Ug.Values) == "table" or type(Ug.States) == "table")
                                            end
                                            if Tg(pg) then
                                            else
                                                local Ug = gg(dg(Ng) .. ".bak")
                                                if Tg(Ug) then
                                                    pcall(ig, dg(Ng), Ug)
                                                    pg = Ug
                                                else
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if type(pg) ~= "table" or type(pg.Values) ~= "table" and type(pg.States) ~= "table" then
                                                Tg = "Config file is empty or invalid."
                                                if rg ~= false then
                                                    Ag(Tg)
                                                end
                                                return false, Tg
                                            end
                                            Vg()
                                            local ig = type(pg.States) == "table" and pg.States or {}
                                            local Ug = type(pg.Values) == "table" and pg.Values or {}
                                            local Jg = ug or {}
                                            local Gg = og or {}
                                            local function Eg(Hg, qg, sL)
                                                local FL = type(Hg) == "table" and Hg[sL] or nil
                                                if type(FL) == "table" then
                                                    if FL.Value ~= nil then
                                                        return FL
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                FL = type(qg) == "table" and qg[sL] or nil
                                                if type(FL) == "table" then
                                                    if FL.Value ~= nil then
                                                        return FL
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                return nil
                                            end
                                            Og.Loading = true
                                            pg, Tg = xpcall(function()
                                                local Hg = {}
                                                for qg, sL in ipairs(v.States) do
                                                    qg = Eg(ig, Jg, sL.Name)
                                                    if not sL._destroyed then
                                                        if sL._configIgnored then
                                                        elseif qg then
                                                            if pcall(sL.Set, sL, qg.Value, false) then
                                                                Hg[sL] = true
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                for ig, Jg in ipairs(v.Tabs) do
                                                    local qg, sL = Ug[Jg.Name], Gg[Jg.Name]
                                                    for Ug, Gg in ipairs(Jg.Sections) do
                                                        ig, Ug = type(qg) == "table" and qg[Gg.Name] or nil, type(sL) == "table" and sL[Gg.Name] or nil
                                                        for Jg, Jg in ipairs(Gg.Options) do
                                                            local Gg, qg = Eg(ig, Ug, Jg.Name), Jg._destroyed
                                                            if (if qg then not qg else not Jg._configIgnored) and Gg and Jg._controller.SetValue and not (Jg.State and Jg.State._registered and Hg[Jg.State]) then
                                                                local ig = Gg.Unit
                                                                if type(ig) == "string" and Jg._controller.SetUnit then
                                                                    pcall(function()
                                                                        Jg:SetUnit(ig, true)
                                                                    end)
                                                                    pcall(Jg.Set, Jg, Gg.Value, true)
                                                                else
                                                                    pcall(Jg.Set, Jg, Gg.Value, false)
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end, function(ig)
                                                return tostring(ig)
                                            end)
                                            Og.Loading = false
                                            if pg then
                                                Og.Active = Ng
                                                tg()
                                                Pg()
                                                hg(false)
                                                if M.configLoadedHook then
                                                    local ig, pg = pcall(M.configLoadedHook)
                                                    if not ig then
                                                        Ag("Config hook failed: " .. tostring(pg))
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                local ig, pg = pcall(Mg)
                                                if not ig then
                                                    Ag("Config callback failed: " .. tostring(pg))
                                                end
                                                if Og.AutoSave then
                                                    _g += 1
                                                    eg(Og.Active, false)
                                                end
                                                if rg ~= false then
                                                    Ag("Loaded: " .. Ng)
                                                end
                                                return true
                                            end
                                            if rg ~= false then
                                                Ag("Load failed: " .. tostring(Tg))
                                            end
                                            return false, Tg
                                        end
                                        Mg = function()
                                            local ig = {}
                                            for pg, rg in ipairs(v.Tabs) do
                                                if not rg._destroyed then
                                                    for Ng, Ng in ipairs(rg.Sections) do
                                                        if not Ng._destroyed then
                                                            for rg, rg in ipairs(Ng.Options) do
                                                                if not rg._destroyed then
                                                                    if not rg._configIgnored then
                                                                        if rg._controller.GetValue then
                                                                            pg = rg.State
                                                                            if pg then
                                                                                if pg._registered then
                                                                                    if not ig[pg] then
                                                                                        ig[pg] = true
                                                                                        G(pg.Callback, pg:Get(), pg, nil)
                                                                                    end
                                                                                end
                                                                            end
                                                                            if (if pg then not pg._registered else not pg) or pg._primaryOption == rg then
                                                                                if type(rg._userCallback) == "function" then
                                                                                    G(rg._userCallback, rg:Get())
                                                                                end
                                                                            end
                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function G()
                                            if Og.AutoSave then
                                                if Og.Loading then
                                                    return
                                                end
                                            else
                                                return
                                            end
                                            _g += 1
                                            local ig = _g
                                            local pg = Og.Active
                                            task.delay(0.35, function()
                                                if ig ~= _g then
                                                    return
                                                elseif Og.AutoSave then
                                                    if Og.Loading then
                                                        return
                                                    end
                                                else
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                local ig, rg = eg(pg, false)
                                                if ig then
                                                    Ag("Auto-saved: " .. pg)
                                                else
                                                    Ag("Auto-save failed: " .. tostring(rg))
                                                end
                                            end)
                                        end
                                        function M.optionChangedHook(ig)
                                            if ig._configIgnored then
                                                return
                                            end
                                            G()
                                        end
                                        function M.stateChangedHook(ig)
                                            if ig._configIgnored then
                                                return
                                            end
                                            G()
                                        end
                                        local function G(ig)
                                            ig._configIgnored = true
                                            if ig.State then
                                                if not ig.State._registered then
                                                    ig.State._configIgnored = true
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return ig
                                        end
                                        local ig, pg, rg = "NinjaLibraryConfig", 1, 1048576
                                        local Ng, Tg = Dg("setclipboard") or Dg("toclipboard") or Dg("set_clipboard") or Dg("writeclipboard")
                                        do
                                            local Ug = type(yg) == "table" and yg.Clipboard or nil
                                            if Ng then
                                            else
                                                if type(Ug) == "table" then
                                                    if type(Ug.set) == "function" then
                                                        local function yg(Jg)
                                                            return Ug.set(Jg)
                                                        end
                                                        Ng = yg
                                                    else
                                                    end
                                                else
                                                end
                                            end
                                            Tg = Ng
                                        end
                                        local function yg(Ng, Ug, Jg)
                                            H.Notify(tostring(Ng), tostring(Ug), Jg)
                                        end
                                        local function Ng(Ug)
                                            if type(Tg) ~= "function" then
                                                return false, "Clipboard copy is not supported by this executor."
                                            end
                                            local Jg, Gg = pcall(Tg, tostring(Ug or ""))
                                            if not Jg then
                                                return false, "Clipboard copy failed: " .. tostring(Gg)
                                            end
                                            return true
                                        end
                                        local function Tg(Ug)
                                            local Jg = mg(Ug)
                                            if not Jg then
                                                return nil, "Selected config does not exist."
                                            end
                                            Ug = gg(dg(Jg))
                                            if type(Ug) ~= "table" then
                                                return nil, "Selected config file is empty or invalid."
                                            elseif type(Ug.Values) ~= "table" then
                                                if type(Ug.States) ~= "table" then
                                                    return nil, "Selected config file is empty or invalid."
                                                end
                                            end
                                            local Gg = fg(Ug) or {}
                                            Gg.Profile = Jg
                                            local Ug, Eg = pcall(function()
                                                local Hg = { Format = ig, ExportVersion = pg, Name = Jg, Config = Gg }
                                                return Xg:JSONEncode(Hg)
                                            end)
                                            if not Ug then
                                                return nil, "Config export encode failed: " .. tostring(Eg)
                                            end
                                            return Eg, nil, Jg
                                        end
                                        local function pg(Ug)
                                            local Jg = tostring(Ug or "")
                                            local Gg = Jg:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                                            if Gg == "" then
                                                return nil, nil, "Paste exported config JSON first."
                                            end
                                            if #Gg > rg then
                                                return nil, nil, "Import is larger than the 1 MB safety limit."
                                            end
                                            local rg, Jg = pcall(function()
                                                return Xg:JSONDecode(Gg)
                                            end)
                                            if rg then
                                                if type(Jg) ~= "table" then
                                                    return nil, nil, "Import text is not valid JSON."
                                                end
                                            else
                                                return nil, nil, "Import text is not valid JSON."
                                            end
                                            Ug, rg = nil
                                            if Jg.Format == ig and type(Jg.Config) == "table" then
                                                Ug, rg = Jg.Name or Jg.Profile or Jg.Config.Profile, Jg.Config
                                            else
                                                if type(Jg.Values) == "table" or type(Jg.States) == "table" then
                                                    Ug = Jg.Profile
                                                else
                                                    return nil, nil, "JSON is not a Ninja config export."
                                                end
                                                rg = Jg
                                            end
                                            local Xg, ig = Lg(Ug)
                                            if not Xg then
                                                return nil, nil, "Exported config name is invalid: " .. tostring(ig)
                                            end
                                            if type(rg.Values) ~= "table" then
                                                if type(rg.States) ~= "table" then
                                                    return nil, nil, "Imported config has no States or Values."
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return Xg, { States = type(rg.States) == "table" and fg(rg.States) or {}, Values = type(rg.Values) == "table" and fg(rg.Values) or {} }
                                        end
                                        local function Xg(ig, fg)
                                            local rg = utf8.len(ig)
                                            if rg then
                                                if rg <= fg then
                                                    return ig
                                                end
                                            else
                                                return ig
                                            end
                                            rg = utf8.offset(ig, fg + 1)
                                            return rg and ig:sub(1, rg - 1) or ig
                                        end
                                        local function ig(fg)
                                            if not (mg(fg)) then
                                                return fg
                                            end
                                            local rg = 1
                                            while true do
                                                local Ug = "." .. tostring(rg)
                                                local Jg = Xg(fg, 48 - #Ug):gsub("[%.%s]+$", "")
                                                local Xg = (if Jg == "" then "Imported" else Jg) .. Ug
                                                if not (mg(Xg)) then
                                                    return Xg
                                                end
                                                rg += 1
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local function Xg()
                                            Vg()
                                            _g += 1
                                            Og.Loading = true
                                            local fg, rg = xpcall(function()
                                                local Ug, Jg, Gg = {}, ipairs, v.States
                                                for Eg, Hg in Jg(Gg) do
                                                    Eg = ug
                                                    local ug = Eg[Hg.Name]
                                                    if not Hg._destroyed then
                                                        if not Hg._configIgnored then
                                                            if type(ug) == "table" then
                                                                if ug.Value ~= nil then
                                                                    Hg:Set(ug.Value, false)
                                                                    Ug[Hg] = true
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                Gg, Jg = ipairs, v.Tabs
                                                for ug, Eg in Gg(Jg) do
                                                    ug = og
                                                    local og = ug[Eg.Name]
                                                    if type(og) == "table" then
                                                        for ug, Jg in ipairs(Eg.Sections) do
                                                            ug = og[Jg.Name]
                                                            if type(ug) == "table" then
                                                                for og, og in ipairs(Jg.Options) do
                                                                    local Jg = ug[og.Name]
                                                                    if not og._destroyed then
                                                                        if not og._configIgnored then
                                                                            if type(Jg) == "table" then
                                                                                if Jg.Value ~= nil then
                                                                                    if og._controller.SetValue then
                                                                                        if not (og.State and og.State._registered and Ug[og.State]) then
                                                                                            if type(Jg.Unit) == "string" and og._controller.SetUnit then
                                                                                                pcall(function()
                                                                                                    og:SetUnit(Jg.Unit, true)
                                                                                                end)
                                                                                                og:Set(Jg.Value, true)
                                                                                            else
                                                                                                og:Set(Jg.Value, false)
                                                                                            end
                                                                                        end
                                                                                    end
                                                                                end
                                                                            end
                                                                        end
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end, function(ug)
                                                return tostring(ug)
                                            end)
                                            Og.Loading = false
                                            if not fg then
                                                Ag("Reset failed: " .. tostring(rg))
                                                return
                                            end
                                            hg(false)
                                            if M.configLoadedHook then
                                                pcall(M.configLoadedHook)
                                            end
                                            pcall(Mg)
                                            if Og.AutoSave then
                                                _g += 1
                                                eg(Og.Active, false)
                                            end
                                            Ag("All features reset to defaults.")
                                        end
                                        local Mg = { Settings = true, Quick = true, Config = true }
                                        local function hg()
                                            local fg = 0
                                            for ug, og in ipairs(v.Tabs) do
                                                if og._destroyed then
                                                else
                                                    if Mg[og.Name] then
                                                    else
                                                        ug = fg
                                                        for Mg, Mg in ipairs(og.Sections) do
                                                            if Mg._destroyed then
                                                            else
                                                                for og, rg in ipairs(Mg.Options) do
                                                                    og = rg._destroyed
                                                                    if (if og then not og else not rg._configIgnored) and (rg.Type == "toggle" or rg.Type == "switch") then
                                                                        if rg._controller.GetValue then
                                                                            if rg:Get() == true then
                                                                                rg:Set(false)
                                                                                ug += 1
                                                                            else
                                                                            end
                                                                        else
                                                                        end
                                                                    else
                                                                    end
                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                        fg = ug
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            return fg
                                        end
                                        Ig = v:GetTab("Settings")
                                        if Ig then
                                            Dg = Ig:CreateSection({ Name = "Defaults", Expanded = true })
                                            Dg:CreateButton({ Name = "Reset to Defaults", ButtonText = "Reset", ConfirmText = "Done!", Note = "Reset every feature to its built-in default", Quick = false, Callback = Xg })
                                            Dg:CreateButton({
                                                Name = "Turn Off All Toggles",
                                                ButtonText = "Turn Off",
                                                ConfirmText = "Done!",
                                                Note = "Switch off every enabled toggle in the feature tabs",
                                                Callback = function()
                                                    local Mg = hg()
                                                    Ag(("Turned off %d toggle(s)."):format(Mg))
                                                end,
                                            })
                                        end
                                        Xg = v:CreateTab({ Name = "Config", Side = "Right" })
                                        Dg = Xg:CreateSection("Config")
                                        xg = G(Dg:CreateLabel({ Name = "Startup Config", Text = "Startup Config: " .. Og.Startup, Note = Og.Startup:lower() ~= Og.Active:lower() and Yg or "" }))
                                        tg()
                                        ng = G(Dg:CreateToggle({
                                            Name = "Auto Save Config",
                                            Default = Og.AutoSave,
                                            Note = "Auto save: " .. Og.Active,
                                            Callback = function(Mg)
                                                Og.AutoSave = Mg
                                                Pg()
                                                if not (vg()) then
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                if Mg then
                                                    local Mg, hg = eg(Og.Active, false)
                                                    if not Mg then
                                                        Ag("Auto Save enable failed: " .. tostring(hg))
                                                        return
                                                    end
                                                    Ag("Auto Save enabled: " .. Og.Active)
                                                else
                                                    Ag("Auto Save disabled.")
                                                end
                                            end,
                                        }))
                                        jg = G(Dg:CreateToggle({
                                            Name = "Auto Load Config",
                                            Default = Og.AutoLoad,
                                            Note = "Auto load: " .. Og.Startup,
                                            Callback = function(Mg)
                                                Og.AutoLoad = Mg
                                                Pg()
                                                if not (vg()) then
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                if Mg then
                                                    Bg()
                                                    if Zg(Og.Startup, true) then
                                                        if Og.AutoSave then
                                                            eg(Og.Active, false)
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                else
                                                    Ag("Auto Load disabled.")
                                                end
                                            end,
                                        }))
                                        Ig = Xg:CreateSection("Profiles")
                                        local Mg = G(Ig:CreateInput({ Name = "New Config Name", Placeholder = "New config name...", Default = "" }))
                                        G(Ig:CreateButton({
                                            Name = "Create New Config",
                                            ButtonText = "Create New",
                                            ConfirmText = "",
                                            Note = "New config copies current settings",
                                            Callback = function()
                                                local hg, fg, ug = tostring(Mg:Get() or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                                                if hg == "" then
                                                    ug = (Rg())
                                                else
                                                    ug, fg = Lg(hg)
                                                end
                                                if not ug then
                                                    Ag(fg)
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                if mg(ug) then
                                                    Ag("Config name already exists.")
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                hg, fg = eg(ug, false)
                                                if not hg then
                                                    Ag(fg)
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                hg = vg()
                                                Mg:Set("", false)
                                                Bg()
                                                Kg(ug)
                                                if hg then
                                                    Ag("Created from current settings: " .. ug .. ". Open Load Config to make it active.")
                                                end
                                            end,
                                        }))
                                        wg = G(Ig:CreateActionMultiDropdown({
                                            Name = "Delete Config",
                                            Options = cg(),
                                            Default = {},
                                            Hint = "Tick the configs to remove, then press Delete",
                                            ButtonText = "Delete",
                                            Callback = function(Mg)
                                                local hg = type(Mg) == "table" and Mg or { Mg }
                                                if #hg == 0 then
                                                    Ag("Tick at least one config to delete.")
                                                    return
                                                end
                                                local Rg, Lg, fg, ug, og, xg = {}, {}, {}, {}, false, false
                                                for Yg, rg in ipairs(hg) do
                                                    Yg = tostring(rg)
                                                    if Yg:lower() == Sg:lower() then
                                                        table.insert(Lg, Yg)
                                                    else
                                                        Mg = mg(Yg)
                                                        if Mg then
                                                            _g += 1
                                                            local _g, rg = Wg(dg(Mg))
                                                            if _g then
                                                                table.insert(Rg, Mg)
                                                                og, xg = if Mg:lower() == Og.Active:lower() then true else og, if Mg:lower() == Og.Startup:lower() then true else xg
                                                            else
                                                                table.insert(ug, Mg .. " (" .. tostring(rg) .. ")")
                                                            end
                                                        else
                                                            table.insert(fg, Yg)
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                                if xg then
                                                    Og.Startup = Sg
                                                end
                                                if og then
                                                    if not (Zg(Sg, false)) then

                local function I()
                    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        if type(isfolder) == "function" then
                            if type(makefolder) == "function" then
                                if not (isfolder("NinjaLibrary")) then
                                    makefolder("NinjaLibrary")
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        )
                    end)

                s.Apply = function(l, t)
                    local m, M = {}, {}
                    for S, S in ipairs(type(l) == "table" and l or {}) do
                        if s.Labels[S] then
                            if not M[S] then
                                M[S] = true
                                m[#m + 1] = S
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #m > 0 then
                        for S, y in ipairs(s.Default) do
                            if not M[y] then
                                M[y] = true
                                S = 1
                                for D = table.find(s.Default, y) - 1, 1, -1 do
                                    l = table.find(m, s.Default[D])
                                    if l then
                                        S = l + 1
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                table.insert(m, S, y)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for S, S in ipairs(s.Default) do
                        if not M[S] then
                            M[S] = true
                            m[#m + 1] = S
                        end
                    end
                    s.Order = m
                    table.clear(s.Rank)
                    for M, S in ipairs(m) do
                        s.Rank[S] = M
                    end
                    if not t then
                        I()
                    end
                    for I, I in ipairs(s.Listeners) do
                        pcall(I)
                    end
                    local I
                    t = F
                    if type(t) == "table" then
                        l, m = F, type(F.Wake)
                        if m == "function" then
                            pcall(F.Wake)
                        end
                    end
                end

                    local I = Q

                    if type(l) ~= "table" then
                        return false
                    elseif type(l.Wanted) ~= "function" then
                        return false
                    end
                    I = type(F) == "number" and F or s.Rank[F]
                    if (s.Rank.Treadmill or 99) >= (I or 99) then
                        return false
                    end
                    I, F = pcall(l.Wanted)
                    return I and F == true
                end
                s.StealRank = function(F)
                    if type(F) ~= "table" then
                        return 1 / 0
                    end
                    if F.Forced ~= nil then
                        return 0
                    elseif F.Priority == true then
                        return 0
                    end
                    local I = 1 / 0
                    I = if F.Index ~= nil then math.min(I, s.Rank.StealIndex or 99) else I
                    I = if F.Passed == true then math.min(I, s.Rank.StealFilter or 99) else I
                    if F.Wisp == true then
                        local F, l, l = s.Rank.StealWisp or 99, Q, type(Q.WispEternalStage)
                        if l == "function" then
                            local l = Q
                            F = if l.WispEternalStage()
                                then math.min(F, (s.Rank.StealFilter or 1) + 0.5)
                                else F
                        else
                        end
                        I = math.min(I, F)
                    else
                    end
                    return if I == 1 / 0 then s.Rank.StealFilter or 99 else I
                end
                s.StealTop = function()
                    return math.min(s.Rank.StealIndex or 99, s.Rank.StealFilter or 99, s.Rank.StealWisp or 99)
                end

                        if type(N.EarningsFor) == "function" then
                            local r, T = pcall(N.EarningsFor, type(p) == "table" and p or {})
                            if r then
                                if type(T) == "number" then
                                    return T
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return 1
                end
                local function p(r, N)
                    local T = tonumber(r.AssetScale) or 1
                    return N * (T > 5 and (T / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or T ^ 1.85) * Z(r.Mutations)
                end
                local function Z(r, N, T, U, J)
                    if type(r) ~= "table" then
                        return false
                    elseif r.Uid == nil then
                        return false
                    end
                    if N[tostring(r.AreaId)] ~= true then
                        return false
                    end
                    N = tostring(r.AssetCategory)
                    local G, E = K(N)
                    if G < T then
                        return false
                    end
                    if next(U) ~= nil then
                        if U[N] ~= true then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    if J > 0 then
                        if p(r, E) < J then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    return true
                end
                local function r(N)
                    return Z(N, _.Areas, _.MinRarity, _.Specific, _.MinIncome)
                end

                end

                local function w(T)

                                        E.Best = {

                                            Category = H,
                                            Record = sg,

                                            Area = tostring(sg.AreaId),
                                            State = T == G and "Mine" or tostring(sg.State),
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                end

                                                e.FreeSteal == 1

                                                        "%d filter eggs here, stealing them first",

                                                    "Found "
                                                        .. (R and select(3, K(R.Category)) or "a filter egg")

                                                        _.CarriedSince == nil
                                                        or os.clock() - _.CarriedSince < k

                                                        "Someone carries a filter egg, waiting in case it drops",

                                                        v, N = "Night is close, staying here", "night"

                                                                            "Waiting for Auto Steal to bring home a filter egg",

                                                                            "Turn on Auto Steal, hopping starts after it brings home a filter egg",

                                                                    end

                                                                end
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            r(w, a)

                                else

                    local V = z

                    sg = {
                        Clock = 0,
                        Factor = 1,
                        Target = 1,
                        NextShift = 0,
                        Phase = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2,
                        Period = 2 + math.random() * 2.5,
                        PauseUntil = 0,
                        Lane = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * E.LaneOffset,
                        Step = function(V, Ig, tg)
                            sg.Clock = sg.Clock + V
                            if sg.Clock >= sg.NextShift then
                                sg.NextShift = sg.Clock + 0.5 + math.random()
                                local Sg = math.max(E.SpeedJitter, 0)
                                if c then
                                    sg.Target = 1 - math.random() * Sg
                                else
                                    sg.Target = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * Sg
                                end
                            end
                            sg.Factor = sg.Factor + (sg.Target - sg.Factor) * math.min(V * 3, 1)
                            local Sg = math.sin(sg.Clock * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / sg.Period + sg.Phase)
                                * E.Wobble
                            if tg then

                                    if E.JumpsPerMinute > 0 then
                                        if math.random() < E.JumpsPerMinute / 60 * V then

                                                Ig.Jump = true

                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            tg = false
                            if c then
                            else
                                if sg.Clock < sg.PauseUntil then
                                    tg = true
                                else
                                    if E.PausesPerMinute > 0 then
                                        if math.random() < E.PausesPerMinute / 60 * V then
                                            sg.PauseUntil = sg.Clock + 0.3 + math.random() * 0.9
                                            tg = true
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return sg.Factor, sg.Lane + Sg, tg
                        end,
                    }
                    return sg
                end

                local function fg()
                    local Og, ug, og, Vg =
                        next(F.Weapons) ~= nil and F.Weapons or F.ToolIds, Q.Character, {}, ipairs
                    local xg = { ug, Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }

                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #og == 0 then
                        return Lg()
                    end
                    table.sort(og, function(bg, wg)
                        return bg.Name < wg.Name
                    end)

                        return tonumber(wg:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0
                    end

                    Vg, ug = xg and table.find(og, xg), og[1]

                        Og = os.clock() - (F.WeaponAt or 0) >= 0.5 or bg(xg) ~= F.WeaponCooldown
                        if #og == 1 then
                            return xg
                        elseif Og then
                        else
                            return xg
                        end

                        for xg = 1, #og - 1, 1 do
                            local wg = og[(Vg + xg - 1) % #og + 1]
                            xg = bg(wg) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                            if xg <= 0 then
                                ug = wg
                                break
                            end
                            if Og then
                                if xg < Og then
                                    ug, Og = wg, xg
                                else
                                end
                            else
                                ug, Og = wg, xg
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    F.WeaponAt, F.WeaponCooldown = os.clock(), bg(ug)
                    return ug
                end
                local function Og(ug, og)
                    local Vg, xg = O(), u()
                    if Vg then
                        if not xg then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local bg = k(ug - Vg.Position)
                    F.WalkSpeed0 = F.WalkSpeed0 or xg.WalkSpeed
                    local wg = ug.Y - Vg.Position.Y
                    local ag = wg > 2 and math.min(wg * 6, 40) or math.min(Vg.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 8)
                    if bg.Magnitude > 2 then
                        wg = RaycastParams.new()
                        wg.FilterType, wg.FilterDescendantsInstances =
                            Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, { Q.Character }
                        local Cg, kg, ng =
                            workspace,
                            Vg.Position + bg.Unit * math.min(bg.Magnitude, 6) + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0),
                            Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)

                            xg:MoveTo(Vg.Position)
                            Vg.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                                Vector3.new(0, math.min(Vg.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
                            return
                        end
                        xg.WalkSpeed = og
                        xg:MoveTo(Vector3.new(ug.X, Vg.Position.Y, ug.Z))
                        Vg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bg.Unit * math.min(og, bg.Magnitude / 0.05)
                            + Vector3.new(0, ag, 0)
                    else
                        xg:MoveTo(Vg.Position)
                        Vg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, ag, 0)
                    end
                end

                            og.WalkSpeed = F.WalkSpeed0
                            F.WalkSpeed0 = nil
                        end
                    end
                end

                local function dg(xg)
                    local bg, wg = Lg(), u()

                            and _g:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == nil

                            and (
                                F.MonsterOrder == "Most Tokens"
                                    and Cg - (Lg[_g:GetAttribute("MonsterSize")] or 0) * 1000
                                or Cg
                            )

                            ng = s
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    ng = Sg and (n(Sg) - wg.Position).Magnitude or ng
                    if not Sg then
                        return false
                    end
                    zg("Fighting a " .. tostring(Sg:GetAttribute("MonsterSize") or "Halloween") .. " monster")
                    local function s()
                        local ag = u()
                        return xg()
                            and Sg.Parent ~= nil
                            and Sg:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == nil
                            and c("HalloweenCarrying") ~= true
                            and (if ag then ag.Health >= ag.MaxHealth * 0.4 else not ag)
                    end

                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        f()
                    end
                    ug()
                    if Sg:GetAttribute("KilledBy") == Q.UserId then
                        F.Kills = F.Kills + 1
                    end

                end

                local function fg(Og, ug, xg)

                local function I(a)

                        else
                            return nil
                        end
                        cg[#cg + 1] = a
                    end
                    return nil
                end

                end
                local function V()
                    local b = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local w = b and (b:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
                    b = w and (w:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloom"))
                    local a, C = b and (b:FindFirstChild("Bounds")), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                    if a then
                        if a:IsA("BasePart") then
                            w = a.Size.X >= a.Size.Z and a.CFrame.LookVector or a.CFrame.RightVector
                            b = Vector3.new(w.X, 0, w.Z)
                            C = if b.Magnitude > 0.1 then b.Unit else C
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    return CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), C)
                end
                local function b()
                    local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local a = w and (w:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
                    w = a and (a:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloom"))
                    a = w and (w:FindFirstChild("Bounds"))
                    if a then
                        if a:IsA("BasePart") then
                            return a.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                        end
                    end
                    return Vector3.new(6700, 74, -364)
                end
                local function w()
                    local a = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local C = a and (a:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
                    a = C and (C:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloom"))
                    C = a and (a:FindFirstChild("Bounds"))
                    if C then
                        if not (C:IsA("BasePart")) then
                            return b()
                        end
                    else
                        return b()
                    end
                    a = C.Size.X >= C.Size.Z
                    local k = a and C.CFrame.RightVector or C.CFrame.LookVector
                    k = Vector3.new(k.X, 0, k.Z).Unit
                    local n, j = math.max(20, (a and C.Size.X or C.Size.Z) / 2 - 30), os.clock()
                    h.PatrolTravel = (
                        (h.PatrolTravel or 0) + (h.Speed or 320) * math.clamp(j - (h.PatrolAt or j), 0, 0.1)
                    ) % (4 * n)
                    h.PatrolAt = j
                    j = h.PatrolTravel
                    a = j < 2 * n and j - n or 3 * n - j
                    return C.Position + k * a + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                end
                local function a()
                    local C = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local k = C and (C:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
                    C = k and (k:FindFirstChild("ButterflyBloom"))
                    k = C and (C:FindFirstChild("Bounds"))
                    if k then
                        if not (k:IsA("BasePart")) then
                            return b()
                        end
                    else
                        return b()
                    end
                    local C, n, j =
                        Vector3.new(k.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, k.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit,
                        Vector3.new(k.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, k.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit,
                        os.clock()
                    h.CircleAngle = (
                        (h.CircleAngle or 0)
                        + (h.Speed or 320) / 25 * math.clamp(j - (h.CircleAt or j), 0, 0.1)
                    ) % 6.283185307179586
                    h.CircleAt = j
                    return k.Position
                        + C * (math.cos(h.CircleAngle) * 25)
                        + n * (math.sin(h.CircleAngle) * 25)
                        + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                end
                local function C()
                    local k = Q
                    local n = k.Root()
                    if n then
                        pcall(function()
                            n.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                            n.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                local function k(n, j)
                    local _ = Q
                    local Y = _.Root()
                    if not Y then
                        return 1 / 0
                    end
                    local A = n - Y.Position
                    _ = A.Magnitude
                    if _ < 0.5 then
                        C()
                        return _
                    end
                    local n = math.min(h.Speed, _ / math.max(j, 0.016666666666666666))
                    pcall(function()
                        Y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = A.Unit * n
                        Y.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                    end)
                    return _
                end
                local function n(j)
                    local _ = Q
                    local Y, A = _.Root(), b()
                    if not Y then
                        return
                    end
                    if (Y.Position - A).Magnitude < 1200 then
                        h.RagdollTries = 0
                        return
                    end
                    _ = Q
                    Y = _.IsNight()
                    _ = nil
                    if Y then
                        _ = Y
                    else
                        local v = Q
                        _ = v.WallSealed()
                    end
                    if _ then
                        Y = Q
                        h.Status = Y.IsNight() and "Night, waiting for daylight before the ragdoll TP"
                            or "Waiting for the wall to drop before the ragdoll TP"
                        return "wait"
                    end
                    _, Y = (h.RagdollTries or 0) >= 2
                    if _ then
                        Y = _
                    else
                        local v
                        v, Y = Q, type(Q.RagdollTravel) ~= "function"
                    end
                    if Y then
                        h.RagdollTries = 0
                        h.ClaimBackoffUntil = os.clock() + 10
                        h.Status = "Ragdoll TP did not land, trying again soon"
                        return "wait"
                    end
                    h.RagdollTries = (h.RagdollTries or 0) + 1
                    if h.RagdollTries == 1 then
                        task.wait(1.5)
                    end
                    h.Status = string.format("Ragdoll TP to the butterfly bloom (try %d/2)", h.RagdollTries)
                    local v
                    _ = t
                    Y = _.Character
                    local _ = Y and (Y:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                    if _ then
                        pcall(function()
                            _:UnequipTools()
                        end)
                    end
                    local function _()
                        return j ~= h.Generation or not W() or not d()
                    end
                    Y = Q
                    Y.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 999
                    local j, j, Y =
                        Q, pcall(Q.RagdollTravel, function()
                            return A
                        end, _)
                    _ = Q
                    _.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 2
                    if j then
                        if not (Y == true) then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                end
                local function j(_)
                    local Y, A = { f("NetStand"), f("ButterflyMachine") }, ipairs
                    for v, P in A(Y) do
                        if _ ~= h.Generation then
                            return h.NetClaimed
                        elseif h.NetClaimed then
                            return h.NetClaimed
                        end
                        if P then
                            h.Status = "Going to claim the Butterfly Net"
                            o(P)
                            for Y = 1, 5, 1 do
                                if _ ~= h.Generation then
                                    return false
                                end
                                v = Q
                                Y = v.Root()
                                if Y then
                                    if (Y.Position - P).Magnitude > 12 then
                                        o(P)
                                    end
                                end
                                local o, _ = X("RF/Butterflies/AskClaimNet")
                                if o == true then
                                    h.NetClaimed = true
                                    return true
                                end
                                h.Status = "Net claim: " .. tostring(_ or "no answer")
                                task.wait(0.8)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local function o()
                    local _ = { Green = 0, Blue = 0, Purple = 0, Golden = 0 }
                    pcall(function()
                        local Y
                        local Y = l
                        local l = Y.Save
                        Y = l and l.Get and l.Get()
                        l = type(Y) == "table" and Y.Butterflies or nil
                        Y = type(l) == "table" and type(l.Counts) == "table" and l.Counts or {}
                        for A in pairs(_) do
                            _[A] = tonumber(Y[A]) or 0
                        end
                        h.Essence = tonumber(l and l.Essence) or h.Essence
                    end)
                    h.Counts = _
                    return _
                end
                local function l()

                end
                local function _(Y)
                    local A = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local v = A and (A:FindFirstChild("Build"))
