                local function Y(A)
                    local v
                    local v = t
                    local P = v.Character
                    local e = P and (P:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                    v, P = os.clock() + (A or 2), 0
                    while os.clock() < v do
                        A = Q
                        local B = A.Root()
                        if B then
                            pcall(function()
                                B.Anchored = false
                                B.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                                B.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                            end)
                        end
                        local A = Q
                        if A.Grounded() then
                            P += 1
                            if P >= 8 then
                                break
                            end
                        else
                            P = 0
                        end
                        local P
                        A = I
                        A.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                    if e then
                        v = e:GetState()
                        if
                            v == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                            or v == Enum.HumanoidStateType.None
                            or v == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                            or v == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                            or v == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
                        then
                            pcall(function()
                                e:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.3)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function A(v, P)
                    local e
                    local e = t
                    local B = e.Character
                    local K, Z = B and (B:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), Q
                    local p = Z.Root()
                    if not K or not p then
                        return false
                    elseif not v then
                        return false
                    end
                    Y(0.3)
                    if (p.Position - v).Magnitude > 6 then
                        pcall(Q.FlyTo, v + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), function()
                            return not l()
                        end, y)
                        Y(0.5)
                    end
                    B = Q
                    local r = B.Root() or p
                    if l() and (r.Position - v).Magnitude > 8 then
                        h.Status = "Walking to the machine"
                        local p, N = _("ExitTrigger"), { v }
                        pcall(function()
                            local T = game:GetService("PathfindingService"):CreatePath({
                                AgentRadius = 2,
                                AgentHeight = 5,
                                AgentCanJump = true,
                                WaypointSpacing = 6,
                            })
                            T:ComputeAsync(r.Position, v)
                            if T.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                                N = {}
                                local U, J = ipairs, s[39](T:GetWaypoints())
                                for T, T in U(s:N4(J)) do
                                    table.insert(N, T.Position)
                                end
                                table.insert(N, v)
                            end
                        end)
                        e, B = os.clock() + (P or 15), N
                        for s, s in ipairs(B) do
                            if (r.Position - v).Magnitude <= 6 then
                                break
                            elseif l() then
                                if os.clock() >= e then
                                    break
                                end
                            else
                                break
                            end
                            if not (p and (s - p).Magnitude < 14) then
                                Z = math.min(e, os.clock() + 3)
                                while os.clock() < Z and (l()) do
                                    if
                                        Vector3.new(s.X - r.Position.X, 0, s.Z - r.Position.Z).Magnitude <= 2.5
                                    then
                                        break
                                    elseif (r.Position - v).Magnitude <= 6 then
                                        break
                                    end
                                    K:MoveTo(s)
                                    task.wait(0.05)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            K:MoveTo(r.Position)
                            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.4)
                    end
                    return l() and (r.Position - v).Magnitude <= 8
                end
                local function s()
                    local v = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
                    local P = v and (v:FindFirstChild("Build"))
                    v = P and (P:FindFirstChild("EnchantedTreeInterior"))
                    P = v and (v:FindFirstChild("Markers"))
                    v = P and (P:FindFirstChild("EnterTrigger"))
                    P = v and (v:FindFirstChild("EnchantedTreeEntrance"))
                    v = P and (P:FindFirstChild("EnchantedTreePrompt"))
                    if v then
                        if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then

                                return v, P.WorldPosition
                            elseif P:IsA("BasePart") then

                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return nil, nil
                end

                    if type(h.TripSay) == "function" then
                        h.TripSay(e)
                    else

                    end

                local function e(B)
                    if l() then
                        return true
                    end
                    local K, Z = s()
                    if K then
                        if not Z then
                            h.MachineError = "tree entrance not found"
                            return false
                        end
                    else
                        h.MachineError = "tree entrance not found"
                        return false
                    end
                    local p = Q
                    local r = p.Root()
                    if not r then
                        return false
                    end
                    local N = Z + Vector3.new(0, 3, -12)
                    local T, U = (r.Position - N).Magnitude > 500
                    if T then
                        p = nil
                        p, U = Q, type(Q.RagdollTravel) == "function"
                    else
                        U = T
                    end
                    local r
                    if U then
                        T = Q
                        if T.IsNight() then
                            h.MachineError = "waiting for daylight"
                            return false
                        else
                            p = Q
                            if p.WallSealed() then
                                h.MachineError = "waiting for daylight"
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                        for r = 1, 2, 1 do
                            if B() then
                                return false
                            end
                            local J = Q
                            local G = J.Root()
                            if G then
                                if (G.Position - N).Magnitude <= 60 then
                                    break
                                end
                            else
                                break
                            end
                            P(string.format("Ragdoll TP to the Enchanted Tree (try %d/2)", r))
                            G = t
                            J = G.Character
                            local E = J and (J:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                            if E then
                                pcall(function()
                                    E:UnequipTools()
                                end)
                            end
                            r = Q
                            r.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 999
                            pcall(Q.RagdollTravel, function()
                                return N
                            end, B)
                            G = Q
                            G.TravelCarryUntil = os.clock() + 2
                            Y(0.5)
                        end
                    end
                    U = Q
                    local r = U.Root()
                    if r and (r.Position - N).Magnitude > 60 then
                        if B() then
                            return false
                        end
                        P("Flying to the Enchanted Tree")
                        pcall(Q.FlyTo, N, B, y)
                        Y(0.5)
                    end
                    for N = 1, 4, 1 do
                        if B() then
                            return false
                        end
                        P("Entering the Enchanted Tree")
                        U = t
                        local P = U.Character
                        T, p = P and (P:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), Q
                        r = p.Root()
                        if P and r then
                            pcall(function()
                                r.Anchored = false
                                if (r.Position - Z).Magnitude > 30 then
                                    P:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Z + Vector3.new(0, 1, -12)))
                                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                                end
                            end)
                            local P = 0
                            while T and P < 3 and (r.Position - Z).Magnitude > 4 do
                                T:MoveTo(Z)
                                P += task.wait(0.05)
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        v(K, N)
                        N = 0
                        while N < 4 and not l() do
                            N += task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                        if l() then
                            task.wait(0.5)
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                    h.MachineError = "could not enter the tree"
                    return false
                end
                local function v()

                        return
                    end
                    local P = _("ExitTrigger")

                                p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    K = 0
                    while K < 3 and (l()) do
                        K += task.wait(0.25)
                    end
                    if l() and P then
                        pcall(Q.FlyTo, P, function()
                            return not l()
                        end, y)
                        K = 0
                        while K < 3 and (l()) do
                            K += task.wait(0.25)
                        end
                    end
                end
                R = Q
                R.TreeTrip = { Enter = e, Leave = v, InTree = l, Settle = Y, Marker = _ }
                local function s(_, Y, ...)
                    local P = f(Y)
                    if not P then
                        h.MachineError = "machine not found"
                        return false
                    end
                    if h.AtStation ~= Y then
                        local f = A(P, 15)
                        if f then
                        else
                            if type(h.TripStopped) == "function" then
                                if h.TripStopped() then
                                else
                                    h.Status = "Trying the tree again"
                                    if not (l()) then
                                        e(h.TripStopped)
                                    end
                                    f = l() and A(P, 15)
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        if not f then
                            h.MachineError = l() and "could not reach the machine" or "left the tree"
                            return false
                        end
                        h.AtStation = Y
                    end
                    for l = 1, 3, 1 do
                        l, Y = X(_, ...)
                        if l == true then
                            return true
                        end
                        h.MachineError = tostring(Y or "no answer")
                        if not (string.find(string.lower(h.MachineError), "closer", 1, true)) then
                            return false
                        end
                        if not (A(P, 8)) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local function X(l)
                    local f, _, Y, A, P, B =
                        h.Recipe, h.TradeCost, l.Green or 0, l.Blue or 0, l.Purple or 0, l.Golden or 0
                    for K = 60, 1, -1 do
                        l = math.max(0, K * f.Golden - B)
                        local B = math.max(0, K * f.Purple + (_.Purple or 50) * l - P)
                        local P = math.max(0, K * f.Blue + (_.Blue or 10) * B - A)
                        if Y >= K * f.Green + (_.Green or 10) * P then
                            return { Essence = K, Green = P, Blue = B, Purple = l }
                        end
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local function l()
                    local f = Q
                    local _ = f.Toggle(h.TradeHandle, false)
                    f = nil
                    if _ then
                        local Y = Q
                        f = Y.Toggle(h.SmartHandle, false)
                    else
                        f = _
                    end
                    return f
                end
                local function f(_)
                    local Y = Q
                    local A, P = Y.Toggle(h.TradeHandle, false), Q
                    Y = P.Toggle(h.CraftHandle, false)
                    if A then
                    elseif Y then
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local B
                    P = t
                    if P:GetAttribute("EnchantedTreeUnlocked") ~= true then
                        h.MachineNote = "Trade and craft need the Enchanted Tree open (finish the Wisp quest)"
                        return
                    end
                    h.AtStation = nil
                    h.MachineError = nil
                    local function B()
                        local K, Z = _ ~= h.TripToken
                        if K then
                            Z = K
                        else
                            local _ = Q
                            Z = _.ButterflyYield() ~= nil
                        end
                        local _, p = Z or d() and W()
                        if _ then
                            p = _
                        else
                            K = Q
                            Z = K.Toggle(h.TradeHandle, false)
                            local _
                            if Z then
                                _ = Z
                            else
                                local K = Q
                                _ = K.Toggle(h.CraftHandle, false)
                            end
                            p = not _
                        end
                        return p
                    end
                    h.TripStopped = B
                    pcall(function()
                        local _ = Q
                        local K, Z = _.Treadmill
                        if K then
                            _ = Q
                            Z = _.Treadmill.Riding
                        else
                            Z = K
                        end
                        K = nil
                        if Z then
                            K = Z
                        else
                            local p, p = Q, type(Q.OnBelt) == "function"
                            if p then
                                _ = Q
                                K = _.OnBelt()
                            else
                                K = p
                            end
                        end
                        if K then
                            h.Status = "Leaving the treadmill first"
                            Z = Q
                            Z.ExitBelt()
                        end
                    end)
                    if not (e(B)) then
                        h.MachineNote = "Could not get into the Enchanted Tree"
                            .. (h.MachineError and " (" .. h.MachineError .. ")" or "")
                        return
                    end
                    local _, e = 0, 0
                    if A and (l()) then
                        P = X(o())
                        if P then
                            local K, Z =
                                ipairs,
                                {
                                    { From = "Green", Count = P.Green },
                                    { From = "Blue", Count = P.Blue },
                                    { From = "Purple", Count = P.Purple },
                                }
                            for p, p in K(Z) do
                                for K = 1, p.Count, 1 do
                                    if B() then
                                        break
                                    end
                                    h.Status = "Smart trade for Enchanted Essence"
                                    if not (s("RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp", "ButterflyMachine", p.From)) then
                                        break
                                    end
                                    _ += 1
                                    task.wait(0.15)
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                        if A then
                            for K, K in ipairs(D) do
                                if h.Trades[K.Label] then
                                    local Z, p = h.TradeCost[K.From] or 10, Y and (h.Recipe[K.From] or 0) or 0
                                    for r = 1, 400, 1 do
                                        if B() then
                                            break
                                        end
                                        if (o()[K.From] or 0) - p < Z then
                                            break
                                        end
                                        h.Status = "Trading " .. K.Label .. " at the machine"
                                        if
                                            not (s("RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp", "ButterflyMachine", K.From))
                                        then
                                            break
                                        end
                                        _ += 1
                                        task.wait(0.15)
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if Y then
                        for Y = 1, 50, 1 do
                            if B() then
                                break
                            end
                            P, A = o(), true
                            for Y, B in pairs(h.Recipe) do
                                A = if (P[Y] or 0) < B then false else A
                            end
                            if not A then
                                break
                            end
                            h.Status = "Crafting Enchanted Essence at the shrine"
                            if not (s("RF/Butterflies/AskCraftEssence", "MutationShrine")) then
                                break
                            end
                            e += 1
                            task.wait(0.3)
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    h.MachineNote =
                        string.format("Last visit: %d trade%s, %d essence", _, _ == 1 and "" or "s", e)
                    if h.MachineError then
                        if _ == 0 then

                            return lg.Info.RarityNumber > Mg.Info.RarityNumber
                        elseif mg == F[3] then
                            if lg.Remaining ~= Mg.Remaining then
                                return lg.Remaining < Mg.Remaining
                            end
                        end
                        if lg.Income ~= Mg.Income then
                            return lg.Income > Mg.Income
                        end
                        return tostring(lg.Id) < tostring(Mg.Id)
                    end)
                end
                local function lg(mg, Mg)
                    if Mg == "" then
                        return true
                    end
                    local Sg = (
                        string.lower(
                            tostring(mg.Info.Name) .. " " .. tostring(mg.Info.Rarity) .. " " .. mg.Status
                        )
                    )
                    for yg, yg in ipairs(mg.Mutations) do
                        Sg ..= " " .. string.lower(tostring(yg))
                    end
                    return string.find(Sg, Mg, 1, true) ~= nil
                end

                local function hg(Rg)
                    local gg
                    local gg = l
                    local l, ig = pcall(gg, Rg)
                    ig = l and type(ig) == "string" and ig or tostring(Rg)
                    ig = string.gsub(ig, "%s*[Mm]utation$", "")
                    return string.upper(ig)
                end
                local function l(Rg, gg)
                    if type(Rg) ~= "table" then
                        return "", nil
                    elseif #Rg == 0 then
                        return "", nil
                    end
                    local ig = {}
                    for Wg, Wg in ipairs(Rg) do
                        table.insert(ig, hg(Wg))
                    end
                    local hg = tostring(Rg[1])
                    Rg = nil
                    if hg == "Rainbow" then
                        Rg = Sg
                    else
                        if hg == "Prismatic" then
                            Rg = Sg
                        else
                            local Sg = mg[hg] or Mg
                            Rg = ColorSequence.new(Sg[1], Sg[2])
                        end
                    end
                    return table.concat(ig, gg or " + "), Rg
                end
                local function mg(Mg, Sg, hg)
                    local Rg, gg = l(Sg, hg)
                    Fg(Mg, Rg)
                    if gg then
                        if Mg:GetAttribute("MutationKey") ~= Rg then
                            Mg:SetAttribute("MutationKey", Rg)
                            hg = Mg:FindFirstChild("MutationPaint")
                            if hg then
                            else
                                hg = E("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, Mg)
                                hg.Name = "MutationPaint"
                            end
                            hg.Color = gg
                        end
                    end
                    return Rg ~= ""
                end
                local function l(Mg)
                    if Mg.Status == "Ready" then
                        return "READY"
                    elseif Mg.Status == "Growing" then
                        if Mg.Remaining == 1 / 0 then
                            return "GROWING"
                        end
                        return Xg(Mg.Remaining) .. "  " .. Mg.Percent .. "%"
                    end
                    return "IN BAG"
                end
                local function Xg(Mg)
                    return string.format("x%.2f", Mg.Scale)
                end
                local function Mg(Sg)
                    local hg = Q
                    return hg.FormatWeight(Sg.Weight)
                end

                local function hg(Rg, gg)

                        Rg.Style = ig

                        Rg.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ig, 1)
                    end
                    Fg(Rg.Text, l(gg))
                end

                        Rg.Image.Image = Wg.Icon or gg.EggIcon or ""

                    end

                    mg(Rg.Mutation, gg.Mutations, "\10")

                    Fg(Rg.Stats.Size, Xg(gg))
                    Fg(Rg.Stats.Weight, Mg(gg))
                    hg(Rg.Progress, gg)
                    Qg(Rg.Select, gg.Id == k)
                end

                        else
                            local D = Q
                            D.Movement.CaptureUntil = os.clock() + b
                            if not (pcall(X, t, h, l)) then
                                w.Mode = nil
                                w.Status = "Retrying"
                                task.wait(0.3)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                        if w.Woken ~= w.Status then
                            w.Woken = w.Status
                            t = m
                            t.Wake()
                        end
                    end
                    l = Q
                    l.Movement.CaptureUntil = 0
                    if z == w.Generation then
                        Y()
                    else
                        l = Q
                        if not (l.Toggle(w.Handle, false)) then
                            Y()
                        end
                    end
                    l = Q
                    w.Status = l.Toggle(w.Handle, false) and w.Status or "Off"
                    l = m
                    l.Wake()
                end
                local z
                O = M
                c = O:FindFirstChild("Packages")
                F = nil
                if c then
                    O = M
                    F = O.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
                else
                    F = c
                end
                c = F and (F:FindFirstChild("RE/EggCapture/StandingsRefreshed"))
                if c then
                    if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        table.insert(
                            w.Links,
                            c.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(F)
                                local z = type(F) == "table" and (F.Entries or F.Standings or F) or nil
                                if type(z) ~= "table" then
                                    return
                                end
                                local X, l, t = ipairs
                                for M, D in X(z) do
                                    local z, X = type(D) == "table"
                                    if z then
                                        F = nil
                                        F, X = I, tonumber(D.UserId) == I.UserId
                                    else
                                        X = z
                                    end
                                    if X then
                                        l, t = tonumber(D.Seconds), tonumber(D.Rank) or M
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                w.Seconds = l
                                w.Rank = t
                            end)
                        )
                    end
                end
                table.insert(
                    w.Links,
                    I.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                        if w.Controlling then
                            V()
                        end
                    end)
                )
                w.Row = nil
                w.Handle = y:CreateToggle({
                    Name = "Auto Capture Event Egg",
                    Default = false,
                    Callback = function()
                        w.Generation = w.Generation + 1
                        local F, z = w.Generation, Q
                        if z.Toggle(w.Handle, false) then
                            w.Status = "Waiting for Capture The Egg"
                            task.spawn(s, F)
                        else
                            local s = Q
                            s.Movement.CaptureUntil = 0
                            w.Status = "Off"
                        end
                        local s
                        F = m
                        F.Wake()
                    end,
                })
                w.TakeHandle = y:CreateToggle({
                    Name = "Take It From The Holder",
                    Default = true,
                    SubOf = w.Handle,
                    Callback = function()
                        local s
                        local s = m
                        s.Wake()
                    end,
                })
                y:CreateSlider({
                    Name = "Hold Height",
                    Min = 20,
                    Max = 120,
                    Default = 45,
                    Increment = 1,
                    Unit = "studs",
                    SubOf = w.Handle,
                    Callback = function(s)
                        w.Height = math.clamp(tonumber(s) or 45, 20, 120)
                        w.Hover = nil
                    end,
                })
                y:CreateSlider({
                    Name = "Keep Away Distance",
                    Min = 20,
                    Max = 150,
                    Default = 45,
                    Increment = 1,
                    Unit = "studs",
                    SubOf = w.Handle,
                    Callback = function(s)
                        w.KeepAway = math.clamp(tonumber(s) or 45, 20, 150)
                    end,
                })
                y = Q
                y.CaptureView = {
                    Row = w.Row,
                    Status = function()
                        return w.Status
                    end,
                    EventRunning = R,
                }
                local s
                u = S
                u(function()
                    w.Generation = w.Generation + 1
                    local s = Q
                    s.Movement.CaptureUntil = 0
                    pcall(V)
                    for s, s in ipairs(w.Links) do
                        pcall(function()
                            s:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    table.clear(w.Links)
                end)
            end
        end
    end,
    a = function(s, ...)
        return (...)()
    end,
}, {}):x4(...)
